children: Mining and transportation conglomerate Grupo Mexico
reported on Tuesday a third-quarter net profit that climbed around 55.9% compared to the same period a year earlier, coming in at $2 billion.
Revenue for the group, a top copper producer, increased 37.9% to $6.33 billion in the quarter, according to a filing.
